source.original_comment: Naming inconsistency between acis-progress.schema.json (camelCase: iterationEpisodes, architecturalConstraints, complexityEvidence) and acis-goal.schema.json (snake_case: iteration_episodes, architectural_constraints, complexity_evidence). This extends to nested properties. Will cause confusion and bugs in tooling.

detection.pattern: camelCase property names in progress schema that should match goal schema convention

verifiable_metrics.name: camelCase vs snake_case naming mismatches between schemas
verifiable_metrics.verification_notes: After fix, all property names in progress schema should use same convention as goal schema

complexity.reasoning: Intentional design: progress schema uses camelCase to match existing convention (goalId, agentType etc). Both schemas are valid but serve different contexts.

remediation.guidance: DECISION REQUIRED: The progress schema already uses camelCase (goalId, agentType, filesModified). The new properties follow this convention. The goal schema uses snake_case. This is an intentional split. Options: (A) Accept dual convention (document it), (B) Migrate progress schema to snake_case, (C) Migrate goal schema to camelCase.
